Develop and implement Quality Management Systems (QMS), policies, procedures, and standards. Establish quality assurance and quality control processes across projects and business functions. Oversee quality audits, compliance reviews, inspections, and performance assessments. Monitor quality KPIs, trends, risks, and improvement initiatives through effective reporting. 610596188600dba7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ادوية فاركو انترناشيونال عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والتأهيل للأنظمة الهندسية الحيوية داخل الشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مسؤولية الإشراف على مجموعة من المهام الهندسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة العمليات. تشمل هذه المسؤوليات: الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والتأهيل لأنظمة التكييف المركزي. التعامل مع ضواغط الهواء وغلايات البخار والمرافق الهندسية الأخرى. المهام التشغيلية تشمل المهام التشغيلية اليومية لهذا الدور مجموعة من الأنشطة الهندسية التي تضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على تطبيق المعرفة الهندسية في بيئة صناعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن شركة ادوية فاركو انترناشيونال. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في الحفاظ على كفاءة البنية التحتية الهندسية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى التقديم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد عملية التقييم.

614e72981e1a1def.description: About the Role Batterjee Medical College in Makkah is seeking a Senior Cloud Administrator to manage, optimize, and secure its cloud infrastructure within Microsoft Azure. This full-time role, based in Jeddah or Makkah, requires expertise across SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS solutions to ensure high availability, security, and performance of cloud-based services. The Senior Cloud Administrator will collaborate with various teams to design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud solutions aligned with business needs. Key Responsibilities Administer and optimize cloud infrastructure in Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and databases. Manage Microsoft 365 platforms, including users, groups, Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams. Oversee the deployment and management of various cloud services, ensuring seamless integration and efficient resource utilization. Implement security best practices, monitor cloud environments for threats, and ensure compliance with industry standards (*, ISO 27001, NIST, NCA, PDPL). Manage Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control (RBAC), and multi-factor authentication (MFA) to enforce security policies. Develop and maintain cloud backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans. Utilize Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and other tools to track system health, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance. Implement automation using PowerShell, Terraform, ARM templates, or other tools to enhance efficiency. Manage virtual networks, VPNs, ExpressRoute, load balancers, and firewalls to ensure secure and reliable cloud connectivity. Ensure cloud infrastructure is regularly updated with security patches and service improvements. Monitor cloud usage, analyze cost trends, and implement strategies to optimize cloud spending. Collaborate with development, security, and IT teams to provide guidance on cloud best practices and troubleshoot cloud-related issues. Maintain detailed technical documentation and provide training to IT staff on Azure cloud operations. Qualifications and Experience Master's or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 8-15 years of experience in cloud administration, with a strong focus on Azure services. Professional certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500). Required Skills Proficiency in managing Azure resources, including virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes, storage, and networking. Strong knowledge of cloud security principles, including identity management, encryption, and compliance frameworks. Experience with automation tools such as PowerShell scripting. Knowledge of cloud-based database services such as Azure SQL. Experience in Windows servers, Linux, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and documentation abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah. The role involves working within a collaborative IT environment to support the college's cloud infrastructure. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

61b6776a2f563d76.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سرعه التعمير للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الوجه، تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والإصلاح للمشاريع والمباني والمجمعات، مع التركيز على تطبيق برامج وإجراءات الصيانة المبرمجة. الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والإصلاح للمشاريع والمباني والمجمعات. خبرة في برامج وإجراءات الصيانة المبرمجة. القدرة على تنظيم وتخطيط العمليات اليومية وأعمال الصيانة الوقائية قصيرة وطويلة المدى. معرفة واطلاع على الأعمال الفنية التي تخدم أغراض صيانة المباني، مثل: الدهان، السباكة، الطرق، الأرضيات، والأعمال الزراعية. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على قيادة فريق العمل وتوجيهه. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. بيئة العمل سيعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة سرعه التعمير للمقاولات في مدينة الوجه بمنطقة تبوك. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل الميداني والإشراف المباشر على عمليات الصيانة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

61a9891c7312ad1f.description: About the Role On behalf of a leading Publicly Listed Joint Stock Company (Tadawul) headquartered in Riyadh, we are exclusively seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Credit Supervisor & Financial Analyst . In this key supervisory role, you will lead the credit risk management framework, evaluate corporate client solvency, oversee accounts receivable portfolios, and optimize cash flow performance while maintaining strict adherence to corporate governance and regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Credit Risk Assessment: Evaluate B2B clients’ financial health, financial statements, and credit reports (SIMAH/Bayan) to establish appropriate credit limits and terms. Financial Modeling & ECL: Perform financial analysis and compute Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisions in strict compliance with IFRS 9 accounting standards. Portfolio & Aging Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging reports, identify high-risk accounts, and execute effective credit control and recovery strategies. Team Supervision & Cross-Functional Alignment: Oversee credit control workflows, align with Sales & Account Management to ensure smooth collections, and escalate non-performing accounts to Legal when necessary. Executive Reporting & KPIs: Generate periodic executive dashboards tracking Days Sales Outstanding ( DSO ), bad debt ratios, collection efficiency, and credit risk exposure. Compliance & Governance: Ensure all credit actions comply with internal risk policies, audit standards, and regulatory requirements for listed entities. Requirements & Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration. Professional credentials ( CMA, SOCPA, CFA ) are a major advantage. Experience: 4–6+ years of strong experience in credit analysis, financial assessment, or credit control, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of IFRS 9 and financial analysis techniques. Hands-on proficiency with major ERP systems ( Oracle / SAP ) and advanced Excel financial modeling. Familiarity with Saudi credit bureau tools ( SIMAH / Bayan ). Industry Background: Background in publicly traded companies, B2B services, or financial/commercial sectors is highly desirable. Languages: Business fluency in both Arabic and English (spoken and written).

61224fdaa2a5e0f5.job_title: Co Founder & Chief Technology Officer A
61224fdaa2a5e0f5.description: About the Role Virtucruit is conducting a confidential search for a Chief Information Officer for a large, established Saudi organization with significant scale across the Kingdom. This full-time senior executive role, based in Riyadh, involves owning and leading the entire technology agenda as a peer to the executive team, with full ownership of the company's technology function. The salary for this position is not disclosed. Technology Strategy and Execution The Chief Information Officer will define and execute the multi-year technology strategy across infrastructure, enterprise applications, data, integration, and security. This includes setting the target architecture for the group, encompassing ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric. The role requires accountability for the reliability, security, and commercial relevance of the entire technology estate, with a focus on delivering value in quarters rather than years. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the multi-year technology strategy across infrastructure, applications, data, integration, and security. Set the target architecture for the group, including ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric. Make and defend build, buy, and partner decisions that shape the technology estate. Run a modern, reliable enterprise systems environment supporting core business operations. Lead ERP modernization or migration programs to support unified reporting, real-time decision-making, and operational scale. Establish integration and middleware capabilities to ensure core functions operate from a single source of truth. Build the data foundation, warehouse, governance, and analytics layer for commercial, operations, and finance teams. Embed data-led decision-making across senior leadership. Hold full accountability for the company's cybersecurity posture and ensure compliance with regulatory obligations. Own business continuity, disaster recovery, and controls required by internal and external audit. Run a service-oriented IT operation with measurable uptime, response, and cost commitments. Lead the technology program management office, ensuring clear quarterly delivery, transparent governance, and disciplined vendor management. Shape the IT operating model, balancing in-house capability, managed services, and strategic partners. Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to senior leadership. Translate technology into commercial language for the Chief Executive Officer and the board. Manage the technology budget with rigor, including capital allocation, vendor consolidation, and total cost of ownership. Qualifications and Experience Fifteen years or more in enterprise technology, with at least five years at Chief Information Officer, Group CIO, or equivalent level in a complex, multi-site organization. A track record of leading a full technology stack end-to-end, ideally in a regulated or institutionally governed environment. Direct, hands-on experience with at least one major ERP transformation or core systems re-platforming program, from business case to go-live. Deep fluency in enterprise technology, including ERP platforms, integration platforms, cloud infrastructure, data and analytics, and modern security architecture. Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to challenge and partner with operating leaders. Proven cybersecurity and data privacy leadership at the level expected of a major Saudi organization. Vendor management discipline, with a history of consolidating estates, renegotiating contracts, and holding partners to outcomes. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified qualifications are invited to apply for this Chief Information Officer position.

612b27a229715ceb.description: About the Role Amazon Saudi Arabia is expanding its Operations team and is seeking a Fulfillment Center Supervisor. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and involves overseeing shift management within one of Amazon's first-mile fulfillment centers, middle-mile sortation centers, or final-mile delivery stations. The Operations Specialists are integral to the daily operations, ensuring customer orders are processed efficiently at every stage of the supply chain. Role Overview The Fulfillment Center Supervisor drives operational efficiency and maintains high standards across various stages of order fulfillment. This position requires a proactive approach to managing teams and processes in a dynamic environment, contributing directly to customer satisfaction through timely and accurate order delivery. Key Responsibilities Cultivate and maintain a safe working environment by identifying safety opportunities within the work area. Manage and train Associates to ensure high-quality service delivery for customers. Ensure customer orders are fulfilled in adherence to quality and safety guidelines. Provide critical shift-related information continuously to frontline management and operators. Adjust labor allocation throughout shifts to meet and exceed operational plans and forecasts. Engage with support functions and other departments to address common issues or needs in key performance areas, such as process area readiness, 5S, safety, and training. Contribute to solving logistics and supply chain challenges through data analysis, innovation, and process optimization. Work Environment and Physical Requirements This role operates within a demanding fulfillment center environment. Candidates must be able to meet the following physical and scheduling requirements: Ability to lift up to 49 pounds. Ability to stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours. Ability to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach. Work 40 hours per week, with overtime as required. Work flexible schedules, including weekends, nights, and holidays. Application Information This is a full-time position with an undisclosed salary. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Amazon Operations team in Riyadh.

6130ad67f3adaced.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إجادة لتحصيل الديون عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد كشوفات بالمبالغ المستحقة وتحصيلها، بالإضافة إلى تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وحفظ الوثائق المتعلقة بها. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالجهات والأشخاص والمبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل المبالغ النقدية المستحقة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المتابعة والتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ النقدية والرد على استفساراتهم. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات بشكل مستمر. الالتزام بالتعليمات المتعلقة بسرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. التقيد التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات المنظمة لأعمال تحصيل المبالغ. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق وترتيبها وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إعداد الكشوفات المالية وتحصيل المبالغ. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل البيانات وحفظ الوثائق. القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات المالية بسرية ومهنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتعتبر الوظيفة بدوام كامل. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في تحصيل الديون، مع التركيز على الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

61532b6ab00e5d7a.description: Job description Job Purpose Responsible for managing project planning, scheduling, cost control, progress monitoring, forecasting, risk management and reporting for utility-scale PV Solar EPC projects, ensuring delivery within approved schedule, budget and contractual requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the project baseline, detailed schedules and look-ahead plans using Primavera P6. 615466860e005ce4.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is a visionary developer focused on redefining sustainability and creating lasting impact. Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations, ensuring the careful integration of new species with local flora. Botanica aims to cultivate 30 million plants by 2030, shaping the natural landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala, with a team committed to ecological harmony and pioneering new global benchmarks in sustainable development. Role Overview The Manager Landscape Maintenance will oversee landscape maintenance operations across assigned sites in Umluj and Tabuk, ensuring high-quality landscape presentation, plant health, irrigation performance, and operational efficiency. This full-time role involves leading Supervisors and field teams, managing resources, monitoring performance, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and clients to achieve service standards and HSE compliance. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage daily landscape maintenance operations and develop weekly/monthly maintenance plans. Lead and supervise Landscape Maintenance Supervisors, technical teams, gardeners, and field workforce. Oversee softscape and horticultural activities, including pruning, mowing, planting, fertilization, weeding, mulching, and plant replacement. Monitor plant health and landscape quality, implementing corrective actions for pests, diseases, and plant stress. Oversee irrigation performance, coordinate with irrigation teams, and improve water-use efficiency. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure landscape areas meet quality and service standards. Manage manpower planning, workforce deployment, productivity, attendance, and utilization. Monitor landscape maintenance KPIs, work orders, service requests, and client observations, ensuring timely closure. Manage requirements for plants, fertilizers, chemicals, soil, tools, machinery, and other landscape materials. Coordinate purchase requisitions, material requirements, and service requests with Procurement and support functions. Review and validate operational invoices and supporting documentation. Monitor contractor and service-provider performance, ensuring compliance with scope, quality, and safety. Ensure effective utilization and maintenance of landscape machinery, tools, vehicles, and equipment. Ensure full compliance with HSE requirements, environmental standards, and safe working practices. Coordinate with Nursery, Irrigation, HSE, Procurement, Finance, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and other operational teams. Maintain effective communication with clients and stakeholders, addressing operational concerns and service issues. Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Monitor operational costs and resource consumption, identifying opportunities for optimization. Support mobilization and operational readiness for new landscape maintenance areas and projects. Identify operational risks, manpower gaps, quality concerns, and resource constraints, escalating critical matters to the Senior Manager. Coach and develop Supervisors and field teams to strengthen technical capability and team performance. Drive continuous improvement in landscape quality, sustainability, water efficiency, and service delivery. Ensure all landscape maintenance activities achieve business objectives, client expectations, and quality standards. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in landscape maintenance management. Demonstrated ability to manage and oversee landscape operations, ensuring high standards. Experience in leading and supervising field teams and managing resources effectively. Strong understanding of softscape and horticultural practices, plant health, and irrigation systems. Knowledge of HSE requirements and environmental standards. Work Environment This role involves close coordination with various internal departments including Admin, Legal, Finance, Projects, Procurement, Compensation, IT, Marketing, Audit, and HR. The position is based in Tabuk, specifically covering sites in Umluj and Tabuk, and is a full-time commitment. Application Process Join Red Sea Global and contribute to world-class projects in sustainable development. We are seeking professionals ready to make a significant impact.

6185e60b71ef3c31.description: About Al Tayer Group Al Tayer Group, through its retail division Al Tayer Insignia, is a prominent leader in luxury retail across the Middle East. The group manages a portfolio of global luxury brands in fashion, jewellery, home, and department store categories, including Bloomingdale's, Harvey Nichols, and Armani. Al Tayer Insignia has also expanded into lifestyle retail, representing leading brands in the Beauty, Home, Fashion, and Hospitality sectors. About the Role Al Tayer Group is seeking a Department Manager - Beauty to join their team in Riyadh.
